tool.name: RADAR-PD Diagnostic: Structural ranking timing
tool.description: measure standalone native-admitted inference and Galaxy latency

configfiles.configfile: import base64, json, pathlib, sys encoded, source, assets, work, archive = map(pathlib.Path, sys.argv[1:]) if encoded.is_symlink() or encoded.stat().st_size > 6 * 1024**2: raise ValueError('Encoded ranking request exceeds its bound') raw = base64.b64decode(encoded.read_bytes().strip(), validate=True) if len(raw) > 4 * 1024**2: raise ValueError('Decoded ranking request exceeds its bound') request = json.loads(raw) required = {'schema', 'protocol', 'protocol_sha256', 'prepared_scattering', 'implementation_sha256', 'dispatch_key'} if not isinstance(request, dict) or set(request) != required or request['schema'] != 'radar-structural-ranking-benchmark/v1': raise ValueError('One closed data-only ranking request is required') import datetime, hashlib, re, subprocess, threading, time sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/radar-symmetry') from ndip_runtime import runtime_limits, process_usage, usage_delta from gpx_recipe.execution import write_json from gpx_recipe.process import run_scientific from gpx_recipe.symmetry.bundle import unpack, hydrate_source, pack from gpx_recipe.symmetry.compiler import package_signature, file_sha, native_environment, assets as protocol_assets, verify_inputs from gpx_recipe.symmetry.contracts import validate_protocol, digest from gpx_recipe.symmetry.resources import allocation from gpx_recipe.preparation.structural_hints import validate as validate_hints, MANIFEST began = time.monotonic(); entered = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(); initial = process_usage() if request['implementation_sha256'] != package_signature() or not re.fullmatch('[a-f0-9]{24}', request['dispatch_key']): raise ValueError('Ranking worker implementation or dispatch identity differs') protocol = validate_protocol(request['protocol']) if protocol['kind'] != 'structural' or request['protocol_sha256'] != digest(protocol): raise ValueError('Exact reviewed structural protocol required') validate_hints(request['prepared_scattering'], protocol) expected = protocol['source']['sha256'] if file_sha(source) != expected: raise ValueError('Galaxy source differs from its captured protocol') work = work.resolve(); work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False) inputs = unpack(assets, work / 'inputs') hydrate_source(inputs, source, {a['path']: a['sha256'] for a in protocol_assets(protocol)}, expected) if json.loads((inputs / MANIFEST).read_text()) != request['prepared_scattering'] or json.loads((inputs / 'protocol.json').read_text()) != protocol: raise ValueError('Captured ranking snapshot differs from the request') verify_inputs(protocol, inputs) before = {str(p.relative_to(inputs)): file_sha(p) for p in inputs.rglob('*') if p.is_file()} staged = time.monotonic(); log = work / 'native.log'; destination = work / 'ranking' with log.open('w') as stream: result = run_scientific([sys.executable, '-m', 'gpx_recipe.preparation.structural_ranking_native', str(inputs), str(destination)], timeout=600, cancel_event=threading.Event(), cwd=work, env=native_environment(), stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT) if result.returncode or not (destination / 'ranking.json').is_file(): print(log.read_text()[-8000:]); raise RuntimeError('Standalone native ranking did not produce a result') calculated = time.monotonic(); ranking = json.loads((destination / 'ranking.json').read_text()) for name, checksum in before.items(): if file_sha(inputs / name) != checksum: raise ValueError('Ranking changed a captured input') response = dict(schema='radar-structural-ranking-benchmark-result/v1', dispatch_key=request['dispatch_key'], protocol_sha256=digest(protocol), implementation_sha256=package_signature(), allocation=allocation(1), ranking=ranking, scientific_result=False, candidate_pruning_authorized=False) write_json(destination / 'response.json', response) pack(destination, archive, ['ranking.json', 'response.json']) timing = dict(schema='radar-worker-timing/v1', entered_utc=entered, staging_seconds=staged-began, calculation_seconds=calculated-staged, total_worker_seconds=time.monotonic()-began, scope='Worker only; Galaxy queue, image startup, Python imports before this clock and output collection excluded', limits=runtime_limits(), usage=usage_delta(initial)) print('[RADAR MODEL RUNTIME] ' + json.dumps(timing, sort_keys=True), flush=True) if ranking.get('ranking_available') is not True: raise SystemExit('Ranking unavailable; inspect the retained structured response')

param.name: model_assets
param.label: Captured parent, profile, reference and model inputs

tool.help: This isolated timing diagnostic calls the existing production GPX-ranking CLI in the pinned scientific image. It performs native parent/profile/reference admission and model inference, without executing candidate refinements. Input packets remain bounded data-only contracts. All candidates remain in the returned scope. No uploaded script or user-provided command is executed. Only ranking metadata is exported; observed arrays and scratch GPXs remain inside the worker. Requested resources never substitute for measured grants.
